Distribution. Nomewaimea infaustana is endemic to Kauaʻi, where it has been collected from elevations between ca. 1000 – 1300 m. It is likely to also occur at lower elevations, especially in mesic and wet valleys where Pipturus spp. grow. Very few recent entomological surveys have targeted such habitat due to the rugged and remote terrain of Kauaʻi.
